{{2024–25 Big East men's basketball standings}}
The '''2024–25 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team''' represented [[Butler University]] in the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by [[Thad Matta]], in the third year of his second stint as head coach of his alma mater. The Bulldogs played their home games at [[Hinkle Fieldhouse]] in [[Indianapolis|Indianapolis, Indiana]], as members of the [[Big East Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2023–24 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 18–15, 9–11 in Big East play to finish in eighth place. They were defeated by [[2023–24 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] in the first round of the [[2024 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/xavier/2024/03/13/live-updates-no-9-xavier-vs-no-8-butler-in-big-east-tournament/72955855007/|title='A great feeling.' Xavier Musketeers hold off Butler Bulldogs in Big East Tournament|work=[[The Cincinnati Enquirer]]|first=Shelby|last=Dermer|date=March 13, 2024|access-date=September 17, 2024}}</ref> They received an at-large bid to the [[2024 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] where they lost in the first round to [[2023–24 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team|Minnesota]].
